name: Symbiosis, Greater
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 day/level; see text

DESCRIPTION

As symbiosis. In addition, as a standard action, you can absorb all of the fungi’s nutrients to gain regeneration 2 (acid or fire) for 1 round per caster level. While you have regeneration granted from this extract, severed body parts reattach in 1 round if you or another creature holds in place and you do not move or take other actions during that round. Otherwise, detached body parts take 2d10 rounds to regrow.
